title: The Gnosis compensation payment is authorized to skip the Governance Poll and go straight to an Executive Vote
content:
A.4.1.1.1.1 obliges Sky to compensate Gnosis for the spread between the Sky Savings Rate and the Dai Savings Rate on xDai balances over a defined period. The parameters (amount, recipient address, dates) are ordinary values, but the final sentence is a governance-process claim: the payment "should be included in the next available Executive Vote as determined by the Core Facilitator and **is authorized to proceed directly to an Executive Vote without a prior Governance Poll**."

Sky's normal path is Governance Poll first (signalling and legitimation), Executive Vote second (execution). Here the poll stage is pre-empted, and the Atlas text itself supplies the legitimacy that the poll would have provided — amending the Atlas *is* the ratification.

What remains with the Core Facilitator is narrow: timing, not approval. "Next available Executive Vote as determined by the Core Facilitator" gives scheduling discretion only.

The pattern worth noticing is that process exemptions in Sky are granted by *writing them into the ruleset*, not by informal fast-tracking. That keeps the exemption auditable and scoped to one payment, but it also means the Atlas accumulates single-use provisions whose only function is to have bypassed a step.
description: An explicit, per-item procedural exemption written into the Atlas itself — the Core Facilitator only chooses which Executive Vote carries it, not whether it is ratified upstream.
